script: Export documents in Bangladesh? Start with one paper.
The commercial invoice is your bill to the buyer: seller, buyer, goods, quantity, price.
Add your ERC number, HS code and a term like FOB.
Customs values goods from it. With an LC, one typo can hold your payment.
Then list your company on Exportain, and let buyers find you.
